title: ME60101: Non-Conventional Sources Of Energy
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Energy scenario and renewable energy sources: global and Indian situation.
Potential of non-conventional energy sources, economics. Solar energy:
radiation, flat-plate and concentrating collectors, fluid flow and heat
transfer analysis, estimation of solar radiation, active systems, solar pond,
passive space conditioning, power generation, photovoltaics. Principles and
applications of Wave energy, Tidal energy, Biomass energy, OTEC and Geothermal
energy.
